# Makatu Vehicle Transport

> Makatu (Makatu Business Enterprises (Pty) Ltd) is a South African vehicle-logistics company that provides door-to-door and dealer vehicle transport between major cities nationwide.

Makatu moves passenger cars, SUVs, dealership vehicles and fleet vehicles for individuals, dealerships and fleet operators using vehicle carriers. Transport types offered on the quote form are Door to Door, Dealer to Dealer, Dealer to Private and Private to Dealer. The network connects Johannesburg, Pretoria, Cape Town, Durban, Gqeberha and Bloemfontein, with electronic vehicle inspections and electronic proof of delivery (ePOD). Published "from" prices on route pages are estimates excluding VAT; the final quote may vary.

Business details as published on the business profile: operating hours 06:00-23:00; payment terms 30 days; service area nationwide South Africa; typical lead times: Gauteng local 1-2 working days, Cape Town to Gauteng target 5 working days, other long-haul routes confirmed per route. Clients named on the site: Ford South Africa, BMW South Africa and 3G Relocations.

Contact: phone 0872651140, email info@makatu.co.za, office 12 La Bri, Petrus Street, Moreleta Park, Pretoria.
